abstract: BACKGROUND: Mature cystic teratomas of the mediastinum are typically germ cell tumors with indolent growth, with documented annual growth rates often less than 5 centimeters. We report a case with an abnormal growth rate (Average diameter growth rate 7.14 mm/month) and significant increased 18 F fluorodeoxyglucose (18 F FDG) uptake, which challenges conventional diagnostic concepts. CASE PRESENTATION: A 34-year-old female presented with progressive chest tightness. Serial CT imaging revealed a right anterior superior mediastinal mass that grew from approximately 1.5 cm in long diameter to 6.5 cm over 7 months (Average diameter growth rate 7.14 mm/month). 18 F fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography-Computed Tomography(18 F-FDG PET/CT) revealed the lesion with high metabolic heterogeneity, and the maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax 6.9). Pathological examination after thoracoscopic-assisted complete resection confirmed the diagnosis of mature cystic teratoma with mature glial components. CONCLUSION: This case suggests that lesions with rapid growth and significantly increased FDG uptake do not necessarily indicate malignant transformation of teratoma. Multidisciplinary decision-making should be based on dynamic quantitative imaging and metabolic feature analysis.Categories: Pathology, Oncology, Pulmonology.

【背景】縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は、年間増大率が通常5cm未満の緩徐な増大を示す胚細胞腫瘍である。本症例は、通常と異なる増大速度(平均増大率7.14mm/月)と著明に亢進したFDG集積を示し、従来の診断概念に疑問を投げかけるものである。
【症例提示】34歳女性が進行性の胸部圧迫感を訴えた。連続したCT画像で、右前上縦隔の腫瘤が7か月間で長径約1.5cmから6.5cmへ増大した(平均増大率7.14mm/月)。18F-FDG PET/CTでは腫瘤は高度の代謝不均一性を示し、最大standardized uptake value(SUVmax)は6.9であった。胸腔鏡補助下の完全切除後の病理組織学的検査で、成熟グリア成分を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定診断された。
【結論】急速な増大と著明なFDG集積を示す病変が、必ずしも奇形腫の悪性転化を示すとは限らない。多職種による意思決定は、動的な定量画像検査と代謝特徴の解析に基づくべきである。
